summary: Minimal correct fix: Contains(x, S).as_set() returning S matches the intended semantics (x ranges over S) and resolves the AttributeError in Piecewise/relational code paths without altering other behavior.

issues.description: Assumes args[0] is the free symbol being solved for; for Contains(expr, S) with a non-trivial expr (e.g. Contains(x+1, Reals)) as_set() silently returns S rather than the true solution set, whereas previously it raised NotImplementedError. Silent-wrong is slightly worse than explicit-unimplemented for that edge case, but this matches the common usage pattern (Piecewise cond.as_set()) and is a reasonable minimal fix.
